title: Kala

paragraphs: In [Niddah 59b](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.59b.6) they said: “And so Rabbi Abba ruled for Kala”; Hyman reports that [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Niddah.59b.6.1) and [Tosafot](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Niddah.59b.6.1) explain that this is a sage’s name.[^1]

notes.text: Rashi explains Kala as the name of the person who needed the ruling. Tosafot takes it to be a sage’s name and rejects reading the words as “leniently.” [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3045&lang=en) cites both glosses.
